decisive_items: Dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells, with most being IgG4 positive
Most of the IgG-containing plasma cells were IgG4 positive
response.rationale: Elevated serum IgG4 and tissue showing dense IgG4-positive plasma cell infiltration are diagnostic of IgG4-related disease; the positive Streptococcus culture and sinus air-fluid level represent secondary bacterial superinfection rather than the primary process.

rejected.why: No fungal evidence is present; culture grew Streptococcus constellatus and imaging shows air-fluid level, which are not typical of invasive fungal sinusitis.
Streptococcal sinusitis explains the culture and sinusitis, but not the dense IgG4-positive plasma cell infiltrate and elevated serum IgG4, which are more specific for IgG4-related disease.
Tolosa-Hunt syndrome can cause painful orbital apex involvement, but it does not explain sinus opacification, bony erosion, or the IgG4-positive plasma cell pathology.
